Workshop on Formalization: Intensive Exchange & Learning Development (FIELD)

This workshop stems from the LEAN course of the Key Laboratory of Mathematics Mechanization, Chinese Academy of Sciences. The course is under the guidance and assistance of @Lihong Zhi, Jujian Zhang and @Junqi Liu .

Schedule

January 26, 2026,

9:00-9:30: Formalizing the BSD Conjecture in Lean - Speaker: @David Ang

9:30-10:00: Algebraic Number Theory Knowledge Related to Iwasawa Theory and its Formalization - Speaker: @Jz Pan (Jinzhao Pan)
https://acmepjz.github.io/lean-iwasawa/

10:00-10:30: Introduction to the MMProver Mathematical Theorem Automated Prover - Speakers: @Junqi Liu , Yichuan Cao, Ruichen Qiu

10:30-10:50: Break

11:20-12:00: Formalizing the Wu-Ritt Method in Lean - Speaker: @Yuxuan Xiao
https://wuprover.github.io/lean_characteristic_set/

12:00-14:00: Break

14:00-14:30: Constructing Number Theory Benchmarks in Lean - Speakers: @Yunfei Li, @Jiaqi Wang, Dakai Guo, et al.

9:00-12:00: Intensive Development Session
